question: Does a fixed three-second, ideal calibrated lateral landmark view add TUG prediction information beyond speed?
target: same-person, same-visit tft_tug; separate normal 10m walk, not TUG trial duration
source_representation: post-augmentation TRC, but select only 20 original pose landmarks
phone_scope: synthetic orthographic lateral view from multi-camera 3D; not an actual phone camera or MediaPipe accuracy test; scale calibration required
window: TRC midHip movement-only selection per pre-fit QA amendment, then exactly3s; resample30Hz and Savitzky-Golay7 polynomial2 within window
projection: vertical Y plus horizontal travel direction from window endpoints; discard transverse component; ideal alignment
normalization: body-relative displacement / median projected leg length within clip; speed in metres/sec from calibration

views.landmarks_only: all derived features except four speed quantities

timing_note: No labelled heel strikes; three-second interval variation is a noisy proxy; unavailable is missing, never assumed zero

models.lgb_5:
LGBMRegressor(learning_rate=0.03, min_child_samples=15, n_estimators=160,
              n_jobs=1, num_leaves=5, random_state=20261104, reg_lambda=5.0,
              verbosity=-1)
models.lgb_15:
LGBMRegressor(learning_rate=0.03, min_child_samples=15, n_estimators=160,
              n_jobs=1, num_leaves=15, random_state=20261104, reg_lambda=5.0,
              verbosity=-1)

selection: one model/hyperparameter per outer fold/view by minimum mean absolute inner OOF error; same pool all views; train-only imputation/scaling; no target transformation
evaluation: reuse all five old person KFold partitions, five folds each; original repeat0 primary; other4 sensitivity; same298 in every arm
subgroup: age>=65, CTL, TUG<12/12-20/>=20 descriptive only; no subgroup tuning
uncertainty: 10000 paired person bootstraps, seed20261104; report feature minus baseline MAE; repeated partitions conditional, not independent
decision: credible development gain requires paired95% upper bound<0 against both speed baselines; no clinical or single-phone accuracy claim
prior_reuse: people, labels and splits already used for development; source official heldout split not untouched; no new independent external validation
failure_rule: Halt on missing source/CRC/nonfinite keypoints/coverage error; objectively exclude no3s active-span candidates as recorded before fits
numeric_amendment_before_first_fit: Set centered pelvis-height mean to mathematical zero, excluding floating-point residue as a predictor. No other feature, cohort, model or split changes.
window_QA_amendment_before_first_fit: Pose-marker QA found 8 stationary old windows among first 128 checked. No outcome/performance used. Recompute first >=3-second active span from TRC midHip horizontal speed: 0.25s mean >0.2m/s, close <=0.25s gaps. Retain same source visits and original person fold assignments. Exclude candidates with no such span identically in all arms, recording reasons and effective splits. No threshold relaxation. Movement detection uses the same30Hz and7-frame SG-smoothed pelvis coordinates as input extraction, before differentiation, preventing high-frequency stationary jitter from counting as walking. This implementation correction precedes every fit.
window_detection_final_pre_fit: Use30Hz SG7-smoothed midHip; speed = net horizontal displacement over trailing0.5seconds divided by elapsed time, then0.25second moving mean; >0.2m/s, close gaps<=0.25s, first continuous>=3s span. Half-second net motion avoids treating accumulated stationary keypoint jitter as walking. All choices made without outcome/performance inspection.
